research_question: After class conditioning, does undercoverage concentrate in physiological windows where the classifier is highly confident but geometrically unsupported by its predicted-class training manifold?

fixed_diagnostic.feature_space: The same 54-feature representation used by Experiments 13 and 14, standardized using the fitted LDA training mean and scale.
fixed_diagnostic.trust_score: Distance to the nearest retained rival-class training point divided by distance to the nearest retained predicted-class training point.
fixed_diagnostic.density_filter: Within each true training class, compute the Euclidean distance to the 10th nearest same-class point and remove the 10 percent with the largest radii.
fixed_diagnostic.risk_thresholds: For each fold and representation, define high confidence at or above the median calibration confidence and low trust at or below the median calibration trust score.
fixed_diagnostic.threshold_label_use: Risk thresholds use calibration features and predictions only, not calibration labels or heldout labels. Training labels are used only to construct class manifolds, as prespecified.

secondary_outputs: coverage and miscoverage in all four confidence-trust quadrants
continuous confidence and trust summaries for covered versus miscovered observations
subject-level risk prevalence and coverage without claiming subject-conditional guarantees

interpretation_contract.pass: The residual class-conditioned failure is consistent with confident classifier-manifold mismatch. The next repair may use a separately validated confidence-trust score transformation or safe abstention rule.
interpretation_contract.fail: Do not build a confidence-trust gate. Move to protocol/stressor posterior shift, temporal dependence, or other prespecified rivals.
interpretation_contract.mixed: Treat confidence-trust as descriptive only; do not optimize thresholds on these same outcomes.

guardrails: Do not change Experiment 13 or 14 outputs, features, classifier, folds, onboarding split, test split, alpha, or conformal score.
Do not use heldout labels to compute confidence, trust, density filters, or risk thresholds.
Do not choose trust-score hyperparameters or quadrant thresholds after outcome computation.
Do not claim exact individual or subject-conditional coverage.
Do not turn the diagnostic into a repair or deployment gate in this experiment.
Do not claim causal identification: geometric mismatch is a falsifiable mechanism proxy.
No LLM or external API call is permitted or required.
